fields.name: OPTIONS
fields.value:
**Yes** — adopt the amendment
**No** — keep the current rule

fields.name: PASSAGE REQUIREMENT
fields.value: At least **8 affirmative votes out of 12**. Non-votes and abstentions are not affirmative.

fields.name: WHO VOTES
fields.value: One formal vote per franchise, cast by the **Franchise Owner**.

fields.name: EFFECTIVE
fields.value: `[NEXT SEASON / LATER DATE]` • must pass before that Season's dues deadline
